senses.gloss:
भौत भौत, i. e. भूत + अ (vb. भू),
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to spirits, Man. 3, 70.
 2. Demoniac.
 3. Elemental.
 4. Relating to existing beings.
 II. m.
 1. An attendant upon idols.
 2. A worshipper of sprites.

भौतिक भौतिक, i. e. भूत + इक (vb. भू),
 I. adj.
 1. Relating or appertaining to spirits, Man. 3, 174.
 2. Elemental.
 3. Existing.
 II. m. Śiva.
